solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Not liable to find leader leaving phone message implicating European politician

indicators.note: implicating means involving, so the trimmed message wraps round the other pieces
the leader of a word is its first letter, and it leaving means that letter is dropped

parts.note: a phone message is a text
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: Someone tries to escape liability over a phone message that drags a European politician into a scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader leaving' strips the first letter from the message; 'implicating' wraps what remains round the European politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone exempt from a duty or tax is free of it, so not liable.

clue.text: Call up the first lady to obtain approval

indicators.note: to obtain means to get hold of, so the name holds the other piece

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible
OK signals approval

explanation.surface: A phone call to the President's wife to get her approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the first lady' suggests a president's wife; here it is Eve, the first woman in Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bring a memory or feeling to mind is to call it up.

clue.text: Extremely naive about secret hold

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the two outer letters are swapped in order
extremely points to the extremes, the two outer letters of the word

parts.note: close means secretive, as in keeping close about something

explanation.surface: Someone very naive about keeping a secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' gives NE from naive; 'about' turns it to EN.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to enclose something is to contain or hold it within.

clue.text: Always feeding essentially to keep going

indicators.note: feeding means going into, so this word goes inside the other

parts.note: per se is Latin for in itself, essentially
ever means always

explanation.surface: Constantly eating is basically how to keep going.
explanation.walkthrough: PER SE is Latin for 'in itself', so 'essentially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to persist in a task despite difficulty is to keep going.

clue.text: Gave lessons, in time, on anything at all

parts.note: aught is an old word meaning anything whatever

explanation.surface: A teacher who gave lessons punctually, on whatever subject came up.
explanation.walkthrough: AUGHT is an archaic word for anything, as in 'for aught I know'.
explanation.definitionFit: Past-tense synonym: someone who taught a class gave lessons to it.

clue.text: American to be in charge of forwards

parts.note: to head something is to lead it

explanation.surface: An American put in charge of a football team's attacking players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forwards' looks like a noun for attacking players; it is the adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: moving onwards in front, going forwards.

clue.text: Grand old actress with fascinating beauty

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand
Dorothy Lamour was a Hollywood star of the 1930s and 1940s

explanation.surface: A grand old film star of fascinating beauty.
explanation.walkthrough: Dorothy Lamour starred in the 'Road to' films with Bob Hope.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: glamour is an alluring, attractive charm.

clue.text: Rise above a general tendency to accept answer by Conservative leader

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the trend wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: a trend is a general tendency

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the party's name

explanation.surface: A party leader rises above the political trend by accepting an answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to go beyond the limits of something is to rise above it.

clue.text: Swindle duke with my agreement

parts.note: to con someone is to swindle them
cor is an exclamation of surprise, like 'my!'

explanation.surface: A con trick played on a duke, done with the speaker's consent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my' is the exclamation, rendered COR, a British cry of surprise like 'gosh'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: concord is harmony or accord between people or nations.

clue.text: Start of leave

definitions.meaning: the moment a car or racer moves off, as in a quick start from the grid
a short holiday or break away from home, as in a weekend break

explanation.surface: The beginning of a period of holiday leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the start of a race, and a short holiday trip away.

clue.text: Expressing praise for song about a paramilitary group endlessly divided

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the song goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a lay is a song or ballad
the UDA is the Ulster Defence Association, a loyalist paramilitary group

indicators.note: endlessly means without its end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: torn means divided

explanation.surface: A song praising a paramilitary group that is endlessly split.
explanation.walkthrough: The UDA (Ulster Defence Association) is a loyalist paramilitary group from Northern Ireland; 'endlessly' trims 'divided', and 'about' has the song surround both.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: laudatory words are ones that express praise, like a eulogy.

clue.text: Teaching graduate embracing Chinese after a word of warning in advance

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so the degree wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: a BEd is a Bachelor of Education degree

indicators.note: after places the Chinese people's name behind the warning word

parts.note: golfers shout fore as a warning
the Han are the majority Chinese people

explanation.surface: A teacher who speaks Chinese gives a warning ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: The golfer's shout warns of an incoming ball; 'after' sets the Chinese people behind it, and 'embracing' has the education degree hold both.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: doing something earlier, ahead of time, is doing it in advance.

clue.text: Eject in seconds entering into a state of unconsciousness

indicators.note: entering into means going inside, so the abbreviation goes within the other word

parts.note: someone knocked out cold is out

explanation.surface: A knockout that drops someone into unconsciousness in seconds, so they are thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to oust someone is to force them out of a place or position.

clue.text: A gun for example

definitions.meaning: slang for a firearm, especially a handgun
a single item or specimen, as in a fine bit of work

explanation.surface: A gun given as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: slang for a firearm, and a single item or specimen of something.

clue.text: Practise plain writing before appealing

indicators.note: before puts the writing in front of the next word

parts.note: prose is ordinary writing, not verse
cute means attractive, appealing

explanation.surface: Practise writing plainly before trying to be charming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Practise' is the older sense: to carry on a trade or activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Older sense: to carry on or follow a trade or pursuit, as one prosecutes a war.

clue.text: Modest support by Catholic party largely withdrawn

indicators.note: withdrawn means drawn back, so the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: a golf tee supports the ball
RC stands for Roman Catholic

indicators.note: largely means most of it, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a side is a party in a dispute or contest

explanation.surface: A modest supporter of a Catholic party, mostly retiring from view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'largely' cuts SIDE to SID; 'withdrawn' reverses TEE+RC+SID (TEERCSID).
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being discreet means behaving with modest tact and avoiding attention.

clue.text: Amorphous sulphur underneath rock made from mud is seen around Peru and Sweden

indicators.note: underneath, in a down clue, puts the symbol below, so it comes last
around means the rock surrounds the country code

parts.note: shale is a rock formed from compacted mud
PE is the international code for Peru
S is the international vehicle code for Sweden
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: Formless rock lying beneath sulphur, found around Peru and Sweden.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something amorphous has no definite form or structure.

clue.text: Loss of confidence in court retaining old charge for services

indicators.note: retaining means holding on to, so the abbreviation keeps the other pieces inside

parts.note: taken as written
a fee is a payment for professional services

explanation.surface: A lawyer in court, holding onto an old fee, starts to lose nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: getting cold feet means losing nerve before a big step.

clue.text: Take away tons hauled up earlier

indicators.note: earlier means the reversed word comes before the abbreviation
up, in a down clue, means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: carted means hauled

explanation.surface: Tons of material were hauled up before being taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses the word for hauled, as befits a down clue, and 'earlier' puts it in front of the tons abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to detract from something is to take away from its value.

clue.text: "Let" uttered for all to hear

indicators.note: uttered means spoken, so the synonym is taken by how it sounds

parts.note: let means permitted, which is allowed

explanation.surface: The word 'Let' is said out loud so everyone can hear it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uttered' says ALLOWED (let) is pronounced the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: speaking audibly so that everyone present can hear you.

clue.text: Unlikely to be dismissed over insolence

indicators.note: over, in a down clue, puts this piece on top of the next

parts.note: a dismissed batsman in cricket is out
side is old slang for arrogance, putting on airs

explanation.surface: A batsman unlikely to be given out despite insolence.
explanation.walkthrough: SIDE is British slang for haughtiness, as in 'no side about him'.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: an outside chance is a slim, unlikely one.

clue.text: A tendency to be dishonest

definitions.meaning: a natural inclination or flair for something
slang for corrupt, as in a crooked copper

explanation.surface: Someone with a tendency to be dishonest.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a natural inclination or talent, and slang for corrupt.

clue.text: Erects set roughly to accommodate Neeson's first filmed audition

indicators.note: to accommodate means to make room for, so the rearranged letters take in the initial
roughly means not precisely, so these letters are put in a loose new order
first means only the opening letter of the actor's name is used

explanation.surface: A film crew roughly puts up a set to fit Liam Neeson's first screen audition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roughly' turns ERECTS SET into SCREETEST; 'to accommodate' and 'first' set N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Definition: an actor's trial filmed to judge how they appear on camera.

clue.text: Colour of satin pants

indicators.note: pants is British slang for rubbish, so the letters are a mess to be rearranged

explanation.surface: The colour of some satin trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' looks like a garment; it is British slang for bad, here an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a stain is a dye or colouring, as for wood.

clue.text: Begin with an advantage

definitions.meaning: a head ... given to someone in a race

explanation.surface: Starting off with an advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to commence, and a lead given at the outset of a race.

clue.text: Pack up and set off

parts.note: to set something down is to put it
off, as in gone off, means away

explanation.surface: Someone packs their bags and sets off on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set off' looks like a departure but is split into two words, each with its own synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal synonym: to tidy things into storage is to pack them up.

clue.text: Discussion group for potential marines

indicators.note: potential means could become, so these letters could be reshaped into something else

explanation.surface: A discussion group laid on for would-be marine recruits.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a seminar is a small class meeting for discussion.

clue.text: Compass discovered in temporary shelter by former partner

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
a tent is a temporary shelter

explanation.surface: A compass found in a camping tent left behind by an ex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compass' looks like the navigation tool but means range or scope.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: compass in the sense of range or scope, how far something reaches.

clue.text: Insist upon actress performing without cocaine

indicators.note: performing suggests acting out, so the remaining letters are put into a new order
without means lacking, so one letter is taken out

parts.note: C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: An actress insists on performing without taking cocaine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' drops C from ACTRESS to leave ATRESS, which 'performing' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to state something forcefully and maintain it is to insist upon it.
